mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.phone, u.nickname, u.status, u.register_source AS registerSource, u.role, up.study_stage AS studyStage, u.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, AS planCode, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN free_plan.name ELSE paid_plan.name END AS planName, AS subscriptionStatus, AS quotaPeriod, AS tokenLimit, AS tokenUsed, GREATEST(0, - ) AS tokenRemaining, >= AS overLimit, us.current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, us.current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, #{usageMonth} AS usageMonth, #{usageDate} AS usageDate, GROUP_CONCAT(aur.role ORDER BY aur.role SEPARATOR ',') AS adminRolesCsv FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_user_role aur ON aur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{usageDate}
GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.phone, u.nickname, u.status, u.register_source, u.role, up.study_stage, u.last_active_at, u.created_at, us.id, us.status, us.current_period_start, us.current_period_end, us.plan_code, free_plan.name, free_plan.daily_token_limit, paid_plan.name, paid_plan.monthly_token_limit, monthly_usage.token_used, daily_usage.token_used ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_user_role aur ON aur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{usageDate}

SELECT AS planCode, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN free_plan.name ELSE paid_plan.name END AS planName, AS subscriptionStatus, AS quotaPeriod, AS tokenLimit, AS tokenUsed, GREATEST(0, - ) AS tokenRemaining, >= AS overLimit, us.current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, us.current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, #{usageMonth} AS usageMonth, #{usageDate} AS usageDate FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{usageDate} WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT e.usage_event_id AS id, e.feature_key AS featureKey, e.provider, e.model, e.input_tokens AS inputTokens, e.cached_input_tokens AS cachedInputTokens, e.output_tokens AS outputTokens, e.reasoning_tokens AS reasoningTokens, e.total_tokens AS totalTokens, e.trace_id AS traceId, e.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM ai_token_usage_event e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.usage_event_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.id, l.admin_user_id AS adminUserId, admin.nickname AS adminNickname, l.action, l.resource_type AS resourceType, l.resource_id AS resourceId, l.target_user_id AS targetUserId, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_audit_log l LEFT JOIN users admin ON admin.id = l.admin_user_id WHERE l.target_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
